job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Product Manager**.** In this role, you will help shape product strategy, translate business needs into actionable product capabilities, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to drive effective execution

**In this role, you will:**

* Strategize marketing based on assessment of results-based environment and new opportunities for product implementation and enhancements
* Review and analyze development of new products and product lines
* Provide support for product life cycle management
* Review global market dynamics, trends, regulatory impact, and risk management
* Present recommendations to resolve more complex situations and exercise independent judgment
* Develop, implement and maintain products, services and marketing programs
* Adhere to compliance and privacy regulations and policies
* Collaborate and consult with project teams, internal partners and stakeholders, including vendors and third parties

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of Product Management experience, product development experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Posting End Date:**

5 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

role: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
role_title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
* Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. **Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

**Description**

  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Lead or contribute to cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver exceptional products.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer interviews to identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
* Prioritize product initiatives, balancing customer needs, market trends, and resource availability.
* Track product performance using key metrics like adoption and NPS, iterating based on insights and feedback.
* Write clear product requirements and user stories, ensuring alignment with development teams.
* Mentor and guide team members, fostering their development and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Manage trade-offs between short-term and long-term objectives, optimizing for timely delivery and technical excellence.
* This role demands a strong strategic thinking, problem solving and execution capabilities to navigate the fast moving landscape of AI. Your mission is critical and it’s a chance to contribute to a technological narrative unfolding right in front of us.

  
**Additional Job Description:**  

* At least 2-4 years of product management related roles or founder-level experience in building highly technical or developer-facing SaaS products.
* Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* You have an eye for great products and can influence business decisions with qualitative and quantitative reasoning.
* Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and have a track record of successfully launching products.
* A Computer Science, Math, or Engineering degree from a premier institute.
* Experience building Enterprise B2B products or games is a plus.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 **About Company:**  
  
TELUS Digital is the customer experience transformation partner to the world's most admired brands. Our diverse team weaves data, technology, and human ingenuity to deliver differentiated customer journeys, drive operational effectiveness, and scale AI solutions with meaningful value and positive impact.  
  
We craft real-world solutions in the moments that matter, from customer acquisition to lifelong loyalty. Enabled by our global reach - spanning 78,000 experts in 33 countries - and deep industry expertise, we help over 600 organizations make the customer experience feel effortless.  
  
Our solutions span Data & AI, Digital Experience & IT, CX Management and Trust & Safety. At the core of our innovation is Fuel iX™, an enterprise-grade generative AI platform that helps clients safely access and optimize leading LLMs to scale their own AI from pilot to production.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer Statement**  
  
At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicant's qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

job_description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager** to drive product roadmap, vision, and lifecycle management while collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders in a dynamic, agile environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and own the product roadmap, vision, and lifecycle strategy
* Lead product discovery initiatives to identify market needs and opportunities
* Manage multiple scrum teams in parallel based on business priorities
* Communicate with stakeholders to raise and address risks in a timely fashion
* Oversee the use of ADO tools to manage stories and boards
* Collaborate with development teams throughout the agile software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support
* Convey technical solutions and concepts to non-technical management and stakeholders
* Provide accurate estimates to support planning and commitment delivery
* Apply software engineering best practices across product management activities

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of overall experience in IT, with a strong background in product management and product ownership
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science
* Expertise in SAFE and Agile methodologies, or PMP certification
* Experience running multiple scrum teams in parallel according to business needs
* Background in the Oil & Gas industry
* Knowledge of tools like ADO to manage stories and boards
* Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals and their application in large-scale distributed systems
* Understanding of agile software development lifecycle processes, including requirements gathering, design and architecture, development, testing, deployment, and application support
* Experience working in development teams using Agile development processes (Scrum)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the capability to convey technical solutions to non-technical people
* Skills in accurate estimating to make and keep promises
* Demonstrated ability to work and communicate effectively across various disciplines, including non-technical management

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Lead Technical Product Manager, ITC
job_description:
Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Program, Product & Project Management

Location

4/F, WeWork, Embassy GolfLinks, Karnataka, Karnātaka 560093, India

Job ID

R-96314

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This role reports to the Manager, Software Engineering, within Global Procurement Technology at the India Technology Center (ITC) in Bangalore.

The ITC team supports global procurement and corporate functions, enabling NIKE to operate efficiently and at scale across regions. As the lead technical program manager for indirect procurement, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for Source-to-Pay (S2P) solutions and coach TPMs who execute roadmaps for individual product areas.

Successful delivery and operational excellence in this role depend on close collaboration with:

* Senior TPMs, software engineers, architects, analysts, and business partners across indirect procurement products such as Coupa, Tririga, Beeline, Concur, Aravo, and related SaaS platforms
* Core ERP teams (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and Oracle) covering accounts payable, tax, and related domains
* Engineering, security, and enterprise architecture partners
* External SaaS vendors and technology partners
  

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are seeking a seasoned technical program leader with deep expertise in procurement processes and platforms, particularly integrating sourcing and procurement SaaS with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA). The successful candidate combines hands-on S2P and P2P knowledge with proven ability to define multi-horizon roadmaps, lead TPMs, and influence senior business and technology stakeholders in a global enterprise.

  

In this role, you will own product vision and roadmap articulation, portfolio prioritization, program governance, and delivery cadence across scrum teams. You will facilitate workshops and design discussions at the portfolio level, validate requirements and solution approaches, mentor senior and junior TPMs, and partner with procurement leadership to deliver scalable, audit-ready capabilities worldwide.

  

This position is based in Bangalore, India. We welcome applications from candidates currently residing in Bangalore as well as those willing to relocate.
  
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in software engineering, technical program management, or product delivery with a strong focus on procurement processes and platforms, including hands-on experience integrating multiple indirect procurement tools with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA).
* Demonstrated leadership of TPMs or cross-functional delivery teams across P2P and S2P products, SaaS-based procurement systems, and ERP master and transactional data flows.
* Expertise in integration strategy—source-to-target mapping, payload design, transformations, and patterns spanning APIs, events, batch/file, and middleware—with ability to guide architects and engineers.
* Proficiency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Lucid (or equivalents); experience defining prioritization frameworks and operating rhythms for global programs.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and process topics for business, engineering, and vendor audiences.
* Comfort leading in a fast-paced, results-oriented, global environment with competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset: you develop others, model curiosity, and drive continuous improvement across teams and vendors.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

* You will define and communicate the vision and roadmap for enterprise Source-to-Pay and procurement technology that supports Nike's global indirect procurement operations.
* You will lead portfolio-level prioritization with procurement, finance, and technology leaders—balancing demand, risk, cost, and capability—and drive decisions to clear commitments.
* You will translate strategic intent into phased delivery plans, success metrics, and well-scoped backlogs, guiding teams on out-of-the-box SaaS use versus justified extensions.
* You will mentor and develop TPMs and senior engineers on delivery execution, stakeholder engagement, and program governance.
* You will partner with ERP, security, enterprise architecture, and external SaaS vendors to align solutions with Nike standards, integration patterns, and long-term platform direction.
* You will establish program health metrics, release readiness criteria, and escalation paths so teams deliver predictably across regions.
* You will anticipate regulatory, audit, and operational needs (e.g., SOX, data residency, vendor SLAs) and embed them in roadmap planning.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------

### **01 Apply**

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Product Manager**, **Shipping as a Service** (L24)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.

* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

job_description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

job_description:
* Job ID: 11310BR
* Location: India-Bangalore (Remote)
* Work Setup: Remote
* Job Category: Product Management
* Posting Date: October 26, 2026

  

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, customer-focused AI Product Manager to join Deltek’s growing AI Center of Excellence and deliver internal AI-powered products and solutions. You will bridge internal stakeholder requirements, Agentic AI capabilities, and engineering execution to create impactful AI-driven experiences. The role requires solid product management fundamentals, a working understanding of AI/ML technologies, and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.

You will own the roadmap and delivery for assigned AI products, features, or product areas. That includes writing PRDs, defining personas, user stories and epics, running scrum calls, and driving delivery from kickoff to release. You will work closely with AI data scientists, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders. This role reports to the Senior Director, AI Solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

* Contribute to the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned AI-powered products and execute against them.

* Identify business opportunities where AI can create measurable value and bring them forward with supporting analysis.

* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer discovery to inform product decisions.

* Define product goals, KPIs, and success metrics for assigned products and track progress against them.

Requirements, Personas & User Stories

* Author Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) covering problem statement, goals and KPIs, functional and non-functional requirements, process flow, dependencies, risks, and open questions; publish and maintain them in Confluence.

* Define personas and document current-state and future-state processes with internal customers and cross-functional teams.

* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and ready for engineering; validate them with business users.

* Work with the AI/ML team to define quality criteria and test approaches for AI outputs, such as grounding, accuracy, traceability, and usable first drafts.

* Specify human-in-the-loop review and governance controls for AI outputs before they reach customers.

Epics, Backlog & Delivery Management

* Define epics and break them into stories and tasks in Jira; keep the epic-level roadmap and boards current.

* Prioritize and maintain the backlog for assigned products based on customer impact and business objectives.

* Lead scrum calls: stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives, acting as product owner or scrum master as needed.

* Drive delivery end to end, from kickoff to release. Manage scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and blockers across Engineering, Technology, Legal, and business teams.

* Coordinate user acceptance testing, product releases, and rollout, and track the delivered outcome against the agreed KPIs.

AI/ML Product Management

* Partner with AI/ML teams to understand model capabilities, limitations, and performance metrics.

* Document requirements for model training, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Track model and product performance and recommend improvements based on customer feedback and data.

Stakeholder Management

* Communicate product progress, risks, and updates to stakeholders and, with guidance, to senior leadership.

* Align cross-functional partners around product priorities and business outcomes.

* Prepare product updates, business case inputs, and ROI analyses.

Internal Customer Focus

* Gather customer feedback and translate insights into product enhancements.

* Analyze product usage, customer behavior, and market trends.

* Drive adoption and customer satisfaction through data-driven decision-making.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Data Science, or a related field.

* 3+ years of Product Management experience.

* 1+ years working on AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or data-driven products.

* Demonstrated experience writing PRDs, personas, user stories, acceptance criteria, and epics.

* Hands-on experience running scrum ceremonies and driving cross-functional delivery with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

* Working understanding of AI/ML concepts, including supervised learning, NLP, LLMs, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics.

* Experience working with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Business stakeholders.

* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Proficiency with Jira and Confluence, or similar backlog and documentation tools.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

* Exposure to Agentic AI, Generative AI, LLMs, Claude, Copilots, agents, RAG architectures, or conversational AI platforms.

* Familiarity with workflow orchestration and low-code automation platforms such as n8n.

* Familiarity with Cursor AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS AI/ML, Google Vertex AI, or similar platforms.

* Awareness of AI governance, model monitoring, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* Experience contributing to the launch of enterprise AI-native products.

We are building a new AI COE Capability team, and we need the best talent regardless of location.

title: Lead Product Owner / Product Manager
job_description:
**Date de publication :** Oct 29, 2026, 12:00AM
  
Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview:**  
We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Lead Product Owner / Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our flagship commercial ordering platform in international perimeter . The ideal candidate will drive product vision, prioritize features,perform requirement analysis and ensure seamless delivery to meet business needs and improve user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Define and prioritize the product backlog aligning with business goals.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, sales, and technical teams.
* Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle, including feature development, releases, and updates.
* Gather and analyze user feedback, market trends, and business requirements to inform product roadmap.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate solutions and ensure quality delivery.
* Team player
* Support compliance, audit requirements, and process improvements.
* Manage stakeholder communication, escalations, and issue resolution to ensure continuous service excellence.

**Qualifications:**  

* Proven experience in product management or ownership, preferably in commercial or ordering platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to analyze complex requirements , propose quick win solution and translate them into actionable plans.
* Experience with backlog management, release planning, and cross-team collaboration.

We are seeking a proactive and strategic Lead Product Owner / Product Manager with proven experience in managing commercial or ordering platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong stakeholder management skills, a deep understanding of product lifecycle management, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solutions. Experience in driving product roadmaps, prioritizing features, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions is essential. The candidate should be customer-focused, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities to ensure the continuous enhancement and success of the platform.
  
  
You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent.
  
  
Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation.
  
  
**Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante :** n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product manager
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Labor Product Manager, Reporting
job_description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new organization. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**Labor Product Manager, Reporting**

**What you will do:**

Are you energized by turning complex workforce and vendor expense data into clear, actionable financial insights? Join PFI Innovation Centre India as a Labor Product Manager, Reporting. You will lead end-to-end planning, forecasting, and reporting across labor, consulting, and vendor expenses, while strengthening controls, resolving planning issues, and improving forecast capabilities. The role is based in India and reports to the Director, Expense Management; the employee work arrangement will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Lead knowledge transfer, dual-run, and stabilization of the expense processes transitioning to PFI Innovation Centre India, stabilizing, and continuously improving.
* Own the forecasting model and reporting tools for the expense category, building quarterly forecasts and delivering quarterly management reporting, overseeing forecast quality, planning assumptions, financial controls, and variance analysis.
* Partner with Newark Expense Management and respective product teams to clearly document requirements and ensure accurate, timely and complete financials.
* Establish consistent planning calendars, review routines, data-governance practices, and reporting standards.
* Serve as data domain owner for labor and consulting expense data, ensuring data quality, consistent definitions, and governance.
* Drive continuous improvement and automation across labor and consulting expense-planning processes.
* Gather end-user feedback to prioritize and implement enhancements to expense planning and reporting.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Experience in workforce planning, compensation forecasting, and labor expense management.
* Experience planning consulting and vendor expenses, including forecast development and variance analysis.
* Strong financial planning, forecasting, and reporting capabilities.
* Knowledge of financial controls, governance, and data-quality practices.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management and complex issue-resolution skills.
* Experience improving and standardizing financial processes in a complex organization.
* Experience automating planning, reporting, or reconciliation activities.
* Ability to translate detailed workforce and vendor data into concise management insights.
* Experience operating across global and matrixed teams.

**What will set you apart?**

* Hands-on experience with Workday, Anaplan, Beeline, Power BI, or comparable tools.
* Experience transitioning finance processes into a GCC, shared services, or global delivery environment and stabilizing them to steady state.
* Experience leading, coaching, and talent development.

* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Skills:** Workforce Planning , Financial Forecasting , Data Quality

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Avam is an applied and materials sciences company developing biology, chemistry, and materials science products for testing, research, manufacturing, and cleaner energy applications. Working at the intersection of science and product development, the team focuses on bringing technically rigorous products to market that support customers across a range of scientific and industrial use cases.

This Product Manager role will help shape how Avam’s scientific product portfolio evolves to meet customer needs and market opportunities. You will work closely with technical and commercial partners to guide product direction, align priorities, and support decisions that balance scientific depth with business impact.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy and roadmap for Avam’s scientific product portfolio.
* Set priorities for Avam’s products and customer experiences, aligning the work with the organization’s mission and goals.
* Gather input from visitors, staff, and other stakeholders to understand needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop clear product plans, goals, and timelines, and keep work moving from idea through launch.
* Coordinate with teams across the organization to plan, deliver, and improve products, programs, or services.
* Define how success will be measured and track results such as customer feedback, participation, revenue, or other agreed-upon goals.
* Use research and performance data to recommend changes and guide future product decisions.
* Manage product budgets, schedules, and competing requests; raise risks or resource needs early.
* Keep stakeholders informed about priorities, progress, decisions, and results.
* Ensure products and experiences are accessible, consistent with Avam’s values, and useful to the people they serve.
* Document product decisions, processes, and lessons learned to support ongoing improvement.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree or higher.
* 4+ years of product management experience in biotechnology or life sciences.
* Experience managing scientific products from discovery through commercial launch.
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into actionable product requirements.
* Experience with scientific product areas or technical environments such as biotech research tools, diagnostics, lab instrumentation, manufacturing workflows, and cleaner-energy materials applications.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across research, engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection for remote work.

job_description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 27/10/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 2-4 years
* City Noida
* Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a **Product Manager** at Rezo, you will own the complete product lifecycle: from understanding user needs and writing PRDs to managing design and development, launching features, and driving adoption. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who understands internal workflows and is equally comfortable building external modules that customers interact with directly. This is a high-impact role focused on delivering exceptional experiences for enterprise clients while enabling internal teams—from Sales to Analytics—to operate efficiently and at scale.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

• Product Strategy & Execution

- Define and manage the roadmap for customer-facing modules and internal tools that support delivery and operations.

- Translate business goals and user needs into structured product features and intuitive user journeys.

- Prioritize features based on impact, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback.

  

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Gather inputs and drive alignment across teams such as Sales, Project Delivery, Legal, Infra, Customer Success, and Analytics.

- Partner with Engineering to deliver high-quality features on time.

  

• User-Centered Development

- Conduct deep discovery with internal stakeholders and enterprise customers to identify pain points.

- Write detailed PRDs with clear workflows, success criteria, and edge cases.

- Create wireframes or collaborate with the design team to bring concepts to life.

  

• Platform Thinking

- Build scalable systems that work across geographies, teams, and industries.

- Establish feedback loops to continuously evolve internal and external tools.

  

• Analytics & Quality

- Monitor platform metrics, customer behavior, and operational performance to identify improvement areas.

- Collaborate with analytics teams to track adoption, identify friction points, and recommend interventions.

  

### **Requirements**

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field.

  

Experience

* 2–4 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably across platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products.

  

Functional Skills
  
- Proven ability to write high-quality PRDs and lead cross-functional teams.

- Strong systems thinking with experience designing tools that enhance operational productivity.

- Exposure to customer lifecycle workflows, data dashboards, or service automation is a plus.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Figma, Confluence, or similar tools.

  

Behavioral Skills & Attitude

- Customer-Centric Mindset – Prioritizes customer satisfaction and proactive engagement.

- Proactive Approach – Anticipates issues and takes ownership to resolve them.

- Communication Skills – Communicates clearly and persuasively with stakeholders.

- Interpersonal Skills – Builds strong relationships and fosters trust.

job_description:
**Job description**

**We're hiring**

**Product Manager E-commerce, CRO & AI Products**

Own the customer journey for CrazyNeon, a fast-growing custom signage brand serving customers across the US and beyond. This role blends e-commerce product thinking, conversion optimization, data, and applied AI — not a typical roadmap-and-tickets PM job.

Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.Gurgaon **On-siteProduct & Growth4–8 yearsFull-time**

**About CrazyNeon**

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

*The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.*

**What you'll do**

**1. E-commerce product management**

* Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
* Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
* Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
* Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
* Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

**2. Conversion rate optimization**

CRO is a major part of this role.

* Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
* Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
* Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
* Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
* Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

**3. Data & analytics**

* Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
* Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
* Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
* Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
* Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

**4. Customer research**

* Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
* Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
* Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
* Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
* Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

**5. AI & new-age products**

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

* AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
* AI artwork analysis and preflight
* AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
* AI-assisted quoting and configuration
* AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
* AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
* AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
* Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

*You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.*

**6. Product strategy & roadmap**

* Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance.
* Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design.
* Set KPIs for every major initiative.

**7. Experimentation & innovation**

We want someone who's constantly asking: *"What can we do differently?"*

* Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well.
* Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge.
* Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources.
* Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-have**

* 4–8 years in e-commerce product management, growth product management, CRO, digital product management, or similar.
* Strong grasp of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion funnels.
* Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs.
* Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with analytics platforms and user behavior tools.
* Ability to turn data and customer insight into product decisions.
* Experience working closely with developers and designers.
* Solid understanding of UX/UI principles.
* Strong communication and project management skills.
* A commercial mindset — you understand how product changes move revenue.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Shopify or similar e-commerce platform experience.
* Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.
* Experience with personalization or experimentation platforms.
* Experience building or shipping AI-powered products.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI APIs, generative AI, computer vision, AI agents, or automation.
* Experience with custom products, configurators, or design tools.
* Experience in international (especially US) e-commerce.

**Who thrives in this role**

**Data-driven** — you look at the numbers before making product calls.

**Customer-obsessed** — you want to understand why customers behave the way they do.

**Commercially minded** — you know a product only succeeds when it creates measurable business value.

**Experimentation-oriented** — you'd rather test an idea than debate it for weeks.

**Technically curious** — you don't need to write production code, but you can work effectively with engineers and evaluate new technology.

**AI-curious** — you follow AI developments and can spot practical applications, not just hype.

**Entrepreneurial** — you're comfortable when requirements aren't fully defined, and you can build the solution rather than just execute someone else's roadmap.

**Hands-on** — you can move from customer problem hypothesis spec build launch analytics optimization, start to finish.

**How we'll measure success**

Website conversion rate

Revenue per visitor

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

Lead-to-order conversion

Average order value

Revenue from new product experiences

Adoption of new digital/AI products

Customer engagement

Number & quality of experiments run

Reduction in customer friction / manual work

**Why join CrazyNeon?**

This is a chance to build more than another e-commerce website. You'll help build the technology layer behind the next generation of custom signage commerce — AI-powered design, personalization, automation, configuration, and customer experience.

You'll have real ownership, and the chance to take ideas from concept prototype launch measurable business impact.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, e-commerce, product, technology, CRO, and AI — this role could be a strong fit.
